headline: Iranian President Pezeshkian: Our problems have increased manifold and our income has decreased
summary: President Masoud Pezeshkian said economic problems have grown since the war with the US and Israel. He linked high prices to rising costs and lower state revenue from reduced oil sales.
why: Iran's oil exports are central to its state revenue and are affected by sanctions and conflict. Falling oil sales influence global crude supply and Iranian fiscal health.
